findings.section: PROPOSED invocation supervision and deadline contract
findings.note: The gate correctly leaves Windows unsupported today, but future native qualification does not specify how ownership/cancellation survives the CreateProcess-to-Job-attachment window or launcher/supervisor loss. Suspended creation prevents code execution before containment but does not itself terminate an orphan or resolve cancel-vs-resume races. Define a concrete broker/outer-containment mechanism and evidence, or keep Windows unsupported; requirements alone are not qualification.
